signIn.tagline: Community review of reported content, one case at a time.
signIn.unconfigured: Sign-in is unavailable: no Oxy client has been registered for this app yet.

notFound.body: Nothing lives at that address. Cases are never reachable by URL — the server assigns one when you ask for it.
notFound.title: This page does not exist.
notFound.heading: Not found

boundary.title: Something went wrong
boundary.message: The screen could not be displayed. Nothing you were reviewing was submitted.

principles.title: How review works
principles.assigned: You never choose a case. The server draws one that matches your categories, languages and consent.
principles.blind: You never see who reported the material, who wrote it, who else is reviewing it, or how anyone has voted.
principles.recusal: Stepping back from a case costs you nothing. It is never held against you.

support.title: Looking after yourself
support.body: Change what you are shown, take a break, or stop for the day. None of it needs a reason.

reputation.title: Your reputation
reputation.none: Nothing recorded yet. Reputation is earned by reviewing, and it is only ever yours to see.
reputation.help: Reputation affects how often you are drawn for a case. It never makes your vote count for more than one.

unavailable.title: This part of the service is not running yet
unavailable.body: The screen is finished; the endpoint it reads from has not been deployed. Nothing is being hidden from you, and no sample data is being shown in its place.

unreachable.title: The service could not be reached
unreachable.body: No response from {{origin}}. This is usually a connection problem rather than a fault in the review service.

notHeld.title: This case is no longer assigned to you
notHeld.body: Assignments expire, and an expired one is redrawn to somebody else so the case is not left waiting. Nothing was lost and nothing counts against you.

error.title: That did not work
error.body: The request failed. Nothing was submitted.

home.title: Review
home.rule: You cannot choose what you review. When you ask for a case, the server draws one that matches your categories, languages and consent — and you never see the cases you were not given.

openCase.title: You have a case open
openCase.body: It is held for this session only. Closing the app or reloading the page ends the sitting.

state.title: Where you stand
state.startOnboarding: Read the rules and set your preferences

request.title: Review next case
request.help: This asks the server for a case. It may answer that there is none for you right now.
request.noCase: No case matches you right now. That is normal — try again later.

reviewerState.applicant: Applicant. Finish the rules, consent and preferences to start calibrating.
reviewerState.calibrating: Calibrating. You receive training and gold cases; your answers do not decide real cases yet.
reviewerState.community_reviewer: Community reviewer. You are entered into standard draws for your approved categories.
reviewerState.trusted_reviewer: Trusted reviewer. You reach more complex cases and are drawn more often.
reviewerState.category_specialist: Category specialist. You review specific categories, escalations and some disagreements.
reviewerState.appeals_reviewer: Appeals reviewer. You can sit on appeal juries, never on one you already reviewed.
reviewerState.suspended: Suspended. You are not entered into draws until this is resolved or you recalibrate.

blocker.onboarding_incomplete: Read the rules and set your preferences first.
blocker.suspended: Your account is suspended from draws.
blocker.eligibility_unmet: One or more eligibility requirements are not met. See Reliability for which.
blocker.paused_by_reviewer: You have paused assignments. Turn them back on under Wellbeing.
blocker.daily_limit_reached: You have reached the daily limit you set for yourself.

eligibility.personhood: Enough personhood confidence to decide real cases
eligibility.age: An age compatible with your categories
eligibility.language_region: A compatible language and cultural region
eligibility.no_conflict: No relationship to the people or application involved
eligibility.no_coordination_signals: No signals of a shared device or coordinated group
eligibility.no_prior_participation: No previous involvement in this case or incident

category.integrity.help: Spam, scams, fraud, impersonation and coordinated manipulation.
category.harassment.help: Insults, targeted abuse, sexual harassment, doxxing and credible threats.
category.hate.help: Dehumanisation, slurs, incitement and targeting of protected groups.
category.violence.help: Graphic violence, threats, instructions and celebration of violence.
category.sexual_content.help: Nudity, explicit activity, and non-consensual or exploitative material.
category.privacy.help: Personal information, intimate media and exposure of someone's location.
category.commerce.help: Prohibited items, counterfeits, misleading listings and unsafe products.
category.platform_abuse.help: Ban evasion, abuse of the report system and automation abuse.

onboarding.title: Before you review anything
onboarding.subtitle: The rules, your consent, and what you are willing to look at.

what.title: What this is
what.body: Applications send reports here. Cases are drawn to small juries of ordinary people, reviewed blind, and decided by consensus. A report is not a verdict, and a verdict is not a punishment — the application decides what to do with the finding.

rules.title: The rules you are agreeing to
rules.help: These are not house style. They are what makes the result worth anything.
rules.accept: I have read these and I agree to them.

rule.noChoosing: You never choose the case you review. There is no queue to browse and no link to a case.
rule.blind: You will not be told who reported the material, who made it, how many reports it has, or how anyone else on the jury voted.
rule.oneVote: One qualified person, one vote. Your reliability affects how often you are drawn, never how much your vote weighs.
rule.recusalFree: You can hand a case back at any time. It is never counted against you.
rule.confidential: What you see in a case stays in the case. Do not save it, quote it or describe it elsewhere.
rule.noSharing: Do not try to identify anyone involved, and do not discuss an open case with anyone.

age.title: Age
age.help: Some categories are restricted by age. This is a declaration, and the server checks it against your Oxy account.
age.confirm: I am old enough for the categories I am choosing.

languages.title: Languages you can review in
languages.help: Only pick languages you read well enough to judge intent, sarcasm and idiom. Getting this wrong is the most common way a review goes bad.

categories.title: Categories you are willing to review
categories.help: You are only drawn for the categories you take, and you can change this at any time.
categories.specialistNote: Child safety is not offered here. It is reviewed only by trained specialists.

sensitive.title: Sensitive material
sensitive.help: Some categories routinely involve material that is distressing to look at. Nothing sensitive is ever shown without you asking for it, and only in a category you have consented to.
sensitive.consentHelp: I consent to being shown sensitive material in this category.
sensitive.needsCategory: Take this category above to consent to its sensitive material.
sensitive.revocable: You can withdraw any of this at any time, from the Wellbeing screen, without giving a reason.

training.title: Training
training.subtitle: Guides, calibration, and where you are in it.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.goldNote: Calibration cases arrive through the same door as real ones and look identical. That is deliberate: it is the only way the figure means anything.

modules.title: Modules
modules.help: Guides and examples for each category you review.
modules.emptyHelp: Modules are published per category. One will appear here when a category you work in has one.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Reviews you completed.
history.empty: You have not completed any reviews yet.
history.decisionPending: The case is still open. You are not shown how it is going.
history.emptyHelp: Reviews appear here once you complete them. Ask for a case from the Review screen.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.subtitle: Your own figures. Nobody else's, and nobody else sees yours.

standings.title: By category and language
standings.help: Reliability affects how often you are drawn and which cases you reach. It never makes your vote count for more than one.
standings.empty: No figures yet. They start once you have reviewed real cases.
standings.emptyHelp: Figures start once you have reviewed real cases in a category and language.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.help: All of these must hold at the moment a jury is drawn.

exposure.title: Exposure
exposure.help: Limits exist so that reviewing stays something you can keep doing.
exposure.break: A break is in progress until {{time}}.

wellbeing.title: Wellbeing
wellbeing.subtitle: What you see, how much of it, and how to stop.

exit.title: Take the case off the screen
exit.body: This removes the open case from this device immediately. It does not wait for the network.
exit.note: This is not a recusal — the case stays yours until it expires. To hand it back, use "Step back from this case" on the review screen.

availability.title: Assignments
availability.help: Turning this off takes you out of every draw. Nothing is held against you for it.
availability.off: You are not being drawn for any case.

limit.title: Daily limit
limit.help: The most reviews you want to be asked for in a day.

categories.title: Categories
categories.help: Remove a category and you stop being drawn for it, starting with the next draw.

consent.title: Sensitive material
consent.help: Consent is per category and you can withdraw it at any time, without giving a reason.

languages.title: Languages
languages.help: Only the languages you read well enough to judge intent and idiom.

support.title: Support
support.body: No support resources or incident channel have been configured for this deployment yet. Until they are, report anything unexpected or distressing through your usual Oxy support route.

noCase.title: No case is open
noCase.body: A case is held in memory for one sitting only, so reloading the page ends it. Ask for another when you are ready.

hidden.title: What you are not being shown
hidden.body: How many reports this has, who reported it, who made it, anyone's reputation, who else is on this jury, and how any of them voted. None of it reaches this screen, and none of it should change what you see in the material.

watermark.note: This material carries a mark tied to your assignment. Screenshots cannot be prevented on every device and we are not claiming otherwise — the mark exists so that a leak can be traced.

context.title: Context
context.help: Only what is needed to judge the material.

contains.title: What does this material contain?
contains.help: Describe what is actually there, in your own reading. Do not decide yet whether it breaks anything.

resources.title: Which part does that apply to?
resources.help: Pick the items your description is about.
resources.empty: This case has no attached material.

missing.title: What context is missing?
missing.help: Say what you would need to be sure. Answering honestly here is worth more than a confident guess.

certainty.title: How certain are you about that description?
certainty.help: About the description only, not about any verdict.

allegation.title: The unverified allegation
allegation.help: This is what the person who reported it claimed. It is a claim, not a finding, and it is shown only now — after you described the material — so that it did not steer the description.

outcome.title: Your outcome
outcome.help: Judge the material against this policy, not against how you feel about the allegation.

context.title: Was there enough context to decide?

findings.title: Findings
findings.help: Name the specific rules you think are broken. Leave this empty if none are.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.help: An exception that applies here, if any.

actions.title: Recommended action
actions.help: A recommendation to the application. The application decides what it actually does.

notes.title: Notes
notes.help: Optional. Anything the jury or an appeal would need to understand your reasoning.

action.recuseNote: Stepping back is never counted against you and needs no justification. The case is redrawn to someone else.

sensitive.title: Sensitive material, hidden
sensitive.body: This is not loaded until you ask for it.
sensitive.noConsent: You have not consented to sensitive material in this category, so it will not be shown. You can consent under Wellbeing, or step back from this case.

resource.unresolved: This item could not be loaded.
resource.linkNotOpened: Shown as text and not opened: following it from here would tell the site who you are and load whatever it chose to serve.
resource.unsupported: This build cannot display a {{kind}} item. If you cannot judge the case without it, answer that context is insufficient, or step back from the case.

submitted.title: Review submitted
submitted.body: Your review is in and the case has left this device. You will not be told how the rest of the jury voted; if the decision becomes disclosable to you, it will appear in your History.

descriptor.minor_appears_present: Someone who appears to be a minor
descriptor.impersonation_claim: An attempt to pass as someone else
descriptor.contested_factual_claim: A factual claim that is contested

missingContext.none: Nothing — I can see what I need
missingContext.author_intent: What the person meant by it

outcome.violation.help: You are confident this material breaks a specific rule you can name.
outcome.no_violation: It does not break the policy
outcome.no_violation.help: You are confident it does not break the policy you were given.
outcome.insufficient_context.help: Not a no. The case needs more material or context before anyone can decide.
outcome.content_unavailable: The material is missing or broken
outcome.content_unavailable.help: The evidence needed is not there, or did not load.

contextSufficiency.insufficient: No, I was working with gaps

recuse.title: Step back from this case
recuse.subtitle: The case is redrawn to somebody else.
recuse.reassurance: This is not a failure and it is not recorded as one. Handing back a case you should not judge is the right call, and it costs you nothing.

reason.title: Why?
reason.help: The reason decides how the case is redrawn — for language, for a conflict, or for exposure. It is not an assessment of you.

notes.title: Anything to add?
notes.help: Optional. You do not have to explain yourself.

done.title: You stepped back
done.body: The case has been handed back and will be redrawn to somebody else. Nothing about this counts against you.

recusalReason.conflict_of_interest.help: Or I have some other reason to be partial here.
recusalReason.language: I do not read this language well enough
recusalReason.language.help: Well enough to judge intent, sarcasm and idiom.
recusalReason.too_sensitive: I do not want to look at this
recusalReason.too_sensitive.help: No explanation needed, now or later.
recusalReason.insufficient_context: I do not have the context this needs
recusalReason.insufficient_context.help: Local, cultural or situational knowledge somebody else will have.
recusalReason.unavailable.help: Better handed back than left to expire.
